13 November 2026 The same ones are tested 73 key 208 For signatures r, z, Ry and 2·min(s,n−s)/n It's taken one median to the key Qx and Qy All six signature pairs have been checked, and the signed controls saved account for the origin of the signatures.

In each three, the parity of halves, parity of quarters and the joint distribution of features according to Pearson were checked 2×8 and 2×64. In each scheme used 2 047 calibration enclosures and 256 independent of zero min-P consider 48 new tests and separately 241 Test the entire series on these controls.
